prompt:
Use case: compositing / logo-brand.
Asset type: one new mobile app icon concept for 리보카 (re:voca).
Primary request: combine concept 1's exact "re:" lettering and brand colors with concept 3's overlapping vocabulary flashcard shape into ONE cohesive icon.
Input images: Image 1 is the typography and color reference; preserve its bold, softly rounded lowercase r and e, large dark terracotta colon dots. Image 2 is the composition reference / base; preserve its warm off-white full-bleed background, two overlapping rounded flashcards, charcoal rear card slightly rotated counterclockwise and lime front card.
Edit instructions: Replace the big "A" on Image 2's lime front card with the "re:" mark from Image 1. The ONLY visible text is exactly "re:". Set r and e in deep charcoal #20251F, the two colon dots in dark terracotta #8D3E24, front card fresh lime #C8F476 and background warm off-white #F9FAF7. Make the front card a little wider and less tall than the reference, a softly rounded near-square flashcard, so the wide re: lettering can be large and readable rather than squeezed. The lettering should occupy about 76% of front card width, optically centered both horizontally and vertically, with breathing room around every side. Keep the rear charcoal card clearly visible as one simple offset silhouette above and left of front card. Exactly two cards.
Composition: polished flat graphic; full square opaque canvas, background extends to all four square corners; combined stack fits centered within the middle 68% of canvas; balanced outer margins. Strong contrast, clean edges and very simple silhouette for small app-launcher size.
Constraints: preserve these references' brand identity and minimal style. No A, extra letters, names, captions, arrows, checkmarks, sparkles, outlines, watermark, phone mockup, presentation board, external frame or rounded outer canvas corners. No photographic lighting, bevel, 3D, cast shadows, paper texture or visible gradients. This is one finished icon concept, not a comparison grid.
